description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Range 60 feet

Targets 1 creature

Duration for the rest of the encounter

Saving Throw Fortitude

Years arrive on the target where anyone can see them. It must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or take a -1 status penalty to attack rolls, AC, and saving throws. At the end of each of your turns thereafter, that penalty worsens by 1, to a maximum of -4. A successful save each round is not offered: this does not stop until the encounter does, or until the target is healed by magic that restores lost time.
